boundaries: Map is a projection, not the poem.
SOUND is approximate Latin-script heuristic in 0.1.
No automatic semantic embedding is claimed.
Jueju historical tone/rime remains OPEN.
Candidate lookup never auto-inserts text.
Forms constrain; they do not score literary value.
Preview never mutates source.
ADOPT is explicit and recorded; LOCK blocks adoption.
0.1 selective-visualization proof remains preserved at /poetry/lab/poem-map/.
Candidate support reports explicit form-envelope compatibility only; it is not a recommendation, ranking or poetry score.
PAGE is the legibility/control entrance; MAP and SETS must earn attention rather than replace reading.
First-use orientation changes disclosure/order only; the 0.2 authoring feature set remains available.
Rendered-browser smoke of the post-rebase orientation/replay changes remains pending; static JS/DOM integrity is verified.
Local corpus contents remain session-only; RETURN records only loaded/token-count metadata and adopted/banked candidate provenance.
Local corpus context is observed co-occurrence, not automatic semantic equivalence.
FIELD LAB marks remain source evidence on handoff; Poem Map does not silently promote them into AUTHOR edges, locks, candidates or revisions.
Cross-surface carry moves exact source/focus only; it does not copy recipient engines, inferred semantics, prosodic claims or authored paths.
Verse Atlas handoff is fail-closed: only exact four-line × seven-Han sources enter the specialist adapter.
Source-spine handoffs are session-local routing state, not durable poem truth; durable authority remains Poem Map RETURN / recipient RETURN.
Return focus is an address witness only; no source bytes, recipient marks, claims or projection state are encoded in the URL.
Focus restoration is fail-closed against the current parsed source; stale or malformed token IDs do nothing.

next_bounded_test.instruction: Bind a real poem/fragment in Poem Map. Select one token in PAGE or MAP. CARRY READ/LAB/STUDY, use the recipient return, and verify the same Poem Map view + token reappear after a full reload; then EXPORT→IMPORT.
next_bounded_test.compare: The three carry operations must reduce re-entry cost without adding a new shared store, universal shell, semantic authority, or permanent control layer.
next_bounded_test.stop: If any recipient mutates poem authorship, creates a path/claim from handoff focus, loses source identity, or requires understanding internal routing to use, stop and revert that seam.
